title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Completion Period Calendar
content:
**Completion period calendar of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, by registry type.** The completion period of a registry opens a set number of calendar days before its event date and ends a set number of calendar days after it, the end day included; when the period ends, the registry closes.

| Registry type | Period opens, calendar days before the event date | Period ends, calendar days after the event date (inclusive) | Registry closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 0 (opens on the event date) | 60 | at the end of the completion period |
| Graduation Registry | 0 (opens on the event date) | 60 | at the end of the completion period |
| Housewarming Registry | 0 (opens on the event date) | 90 | at the end of the completion period |
| Baby Registry | 30 | 120 | at the end of the completion period |
| Anniversary Registry | 0 (opens on the event date) | 90 | at the end of the completion period |
| Wedding Registry | 0 (opens on the event date) | 180 | at the end of the completion period |

### Reading the calendar

- An opening figure of 0 means the period opens on the event date itself.
- The closing figure is inclusive: the period still runs through the whole of the last day counted.

### Worked dates (hypothetical event date)

For an illustrative event date of 10 March in a year that is not a leap year:
- a Baby Registry's period opens 30 calendar days earlier, on 8 February, and runs through 8 July (120 calendar days after 10 March);
- an Anniversary Registry's period opens on 10 March and runs through 8 June (90 calendar days after 10 March).
